sample_unit: neonatal multimodal pain data segments (training); external validation cohort size not reported

links.outcome: Model accuracy on held-out internal test and independent prospective external validation cohort
links.effect: Internal validation 89.6% accuracy, 85.8% F1; external validation on unseen data 87.7% accuracy, AUC above 0.95 across all pain categories.
links.quote: External validation on unseen data reached 87.7% accuracy, with AUC exceeding 0.95 across all pain categories (no pain, mild pain, severe pain).

unlisted_practices: Using low-code AutoML platforms so clinicians can build their own AI tools

screen.reason: Evaluates the feasibility and accuracy of using a low-code AutoML platform to build and externally validate a neonatal multimodal pain classification model.
